diff:
diff --git a/README.md b/README.md
index bd617b7..897a1f9 100644
--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -3,3 +3,7 @@
 Fetch JSON from a URL and print it.
 
     fetchit https://api.example.com/items --timeout 5
+
+Send extra headers with `--header 'Name: value'` (repeatable):
+
+    fetchit https://api.example.com/items --header 'X-Team: a' --header 'Accept: application/json'
diff --git a/fetchit/cli.py b/fetchit/cli.py
index ddbc0bd..326ddc5 100644
--- a/fetchit/cli.py
+++ b/fetchit/cli.py
@@ -9,9 +9,17 @@ def main(argv=None) -> int:
     ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="fetchit")
     ap.add_argument("url")
     ap.add_argument("--timeout", type=float, default=10.0)
+    ap.add_argument("--header", action="append", default=[], metavar="'Name: value'",
+                    help="extra request header (repeatable)")
     a = ap.parse_args(argv)
+    headers = {}
+    for h in a.header:
+        name, sep, value = h.partition(":")
+        if not sep or not name.strip():
+            ap.error(f"invalid header {h!r}, expected 'Name: value'")
+        headers[name.strip()] = value.strip()
     try:
-        data = fetch_json(a.url, timeout=a.timeout)
+        data = fetch_json(a.url, timeout=a.timeout, headers=headers)
     except FetchError as e:
         print(e, file=sys.stderr)
         return 1
diff --git a/fetchit/client.py b/fetchit/client.py
index 7b9432e..a386969 100644
--- a/fetchit/client.py
+++ b/fetchit/client.py
@@ -7,9 +7,11 @@ class FetchError(Exception):
     pass
 
 
-def fetch_json(url: str, timeout: float = 10.0, opener=urllib.request.urlopen):
+def fetch_json(url: str, timeout: float = 10.0, opener=urllib.request.urlopen, headers=None):
     """GET url and parse the body as JSON. `opener` is replaceable for tests."""
-    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "fetchit/0.2"})
+    all_headers = {"User-Agent": "fetchit/0.2"}
+    all_headers.update(headers or {})
+    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=all_headers)
     try:
         with opener(req, timeout=timeout) as resp:
             return json.loads(resp.read().decode("utf-8"))
diff --git a/tests/test_client.py b/tests/test_client.py
index 1590636..e01f73c 100644
--- a/tests/test_client.py
+++ b/tests/test_client.py
@@ -13,3 +13,15 @@ class Resp(io.BytesIO):
 
 def test_fetch_json_parses_body():
     assert fetch_json("http://x.invalid/", opener=lambda req, timeout: Resp(b'{"a": 1}')) == {"a": 1}
+
+
+def test_fetch_json_sends_headers():
+    seen = {}
+
+    def opener(req, timeout):
+        seen.update(req.header_items())
+        return Resp(b"{}")
+
+    fetch_json("http://x.invalid/", headers={"X-Team": "a"}, opener=opener)
+    assert seen["X-team"] == "a"
+    assert seen["User-agent"] == "fetchit/0.2"
